question:
What would be the letter on the opposite side of 'Y' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb3b073825eab28a0b44555c0141da6d1bd2b17b93e1ec79077916cba28fb3b2.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: -

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners.

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface
